name: Keepers 1: Revolution
source:
As the main protagonist awakens after an incident, she notices that she can't go back home anymore.

She meets a strange girl named Rumi and decides to travel with her together.

Without any knowledge of the world, she starts her long journey and soon begins to understand, how horrible this world can be.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
当主角在一次事件后醒来时，她发现自己无法再回家了。

她遇到了一个名叫鲁米的奇怪女孩，并决定和她一起去旅行。

在对这个世界一无所知的情况下，她开始了漫长的旅程，很快就开始明白，这个世界是多么的可怕。

[来自F95Zone]
